messages:
rachel: running into a weird edge with stream_tool_call + dataclass output in the python sample app. structured parsing fails if the tool emits a partial object across chunks.

rachel: minimal repro:

rachel: ```py
from dataclasses import dataclass
from redwood import AsyncClient

client = AsyncClient(api_key=\"...\")

@dataclass
class Result:
    id: str
    score: float
    meta: dict

# tool streams multiple json objects, but sometimes they split across frames
async for chunk in client.stream_tool_call(
    \"rank_batch\",
    input={\"batch_id\": \"b1\"},
    output_type=Result,
):
    # chunk might be '{\"id\": \"x\", \"score\": 0.9, \"meta\": {', then next chunk finishes it
    print(chunk)
```

rachel: error i get: ValueError: Unexpected end of JSON input while coercing to Result

igor: yeah streaming structured output is tricky. SDK currently tries to coerce each chunk independently which is wrong for chunked JSON.

igor: two immediate options: buffer until a full object parse succeeds, or require the tool to emit newline-delimited JSON (ndjson).

sam: for onboarding, our docs show the simple streaming example but don't mention ndjson requirement. that's caused confusion in at least two customers.

rachel: customer hit this in the sample app too. they copied the example and used a streaming model that fragments json. frustrated.

tom: we should support both ndjson and chunk-assembly. propose an API like stream_tool_call(..., assemble_chunks=True, chunk_separator='\n') and expose partial_parse_hook(chunk) so apps can inspect partial frames instead of failing.

igor: also need typing clarity: output_type=Result is documented as working for sync tool_call but not for stream_tool_call. add that to docs and ensure runtime enforces output_type only when assemble_chunks True or when ndjson.

sam: for DX, add a small note in quickstart: \"If your tool streams JSON objects, prefer NDJSON or enable chunk assembly via assemble_chunks=True\". Also add a sample server that emits ndjson.

rachel: logging snippet:

rachel: ```
DEBUG transport recv frame: '{\"id\":\"r1\",\"score\":0.'
DEBUG transport recv frame: '95,\"meta\":{}}'
ERROR coercion failed for chunk: Unexpected end of JSON input'
```

tom: good catch. i'll open an issue and add unit tests for: single-frame object, multi-frame object, malformed mid-stream and ndjson handling.

ci-bot: created issue redwood/sdk#3499 \"stream_tool_call: support chunk assembly for structured outputs and clarify docs\" (assigned to @tom). https://github.com/redwood/sdk/issues/3499

igor: implementation notes: keep a small per-stream buffer and try json.loads whenever buffer contains a closing brace or newline. be careful with arrays vs objects. also add a max_buffer_size option to avoid memory blowups.

rachel: can we also surface parse_errors on the returned stream response so apps can log them per-item? currently they just see exceptions.

tom: yes. we'll return a StreamItem object with fields: raw_chunk, parsed (optional), parse_error (optional), request_id. will keep backward compat by allowing direct iteration over parsed when assemble_chunks True.

sam: i'll update docs and add a snippet showing ndjson server and the new assemble_chunks usage in examples repo.

rachel: thanks. repro + failing customer trace added to the issue. ping me on the PR please. :pray:
